title: Every output is rendered and reports its first error, at its template, line and column, with the output's path and the render tags that led to a partial: an unbound name, self, env, item outside a fan-out, an undeclared or closed member, a property of nil, a bad index, an object written, a comparison of unordered kinds, a tag argument, a filter's input and argument, a decode that is not UTF-8, a result beyond range and a division by zero; and nothing is written
